intro.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Clarksville, IN, by a family-owned team
paragraphs: Livingston General Contracting, LLC. is a family-owned general contractor serving Clarksville, IN. Bri and Trey lead the work, and bathroom remodeling, flooring and decks are what our customers hire us for most. Friendly staff and hard work are the topics that come up most in our Google reviews.

One family started a bathroom and flooring project with a big retailer and was left frustrated when it stalled. We picked up right where it lagged, kept them informed and finished a bathroom they call amazing, with new flooring they call perfect. We even returned items that had been ordered wrong before we took over. Another homeowner found us through a deck we posted on Facebook and says she would use us 100 times over.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: We update bathrooms from the floor up. The bath shown here got a white shaker vanity with a quartz top and black pulls, sage green walls and marble-look tile on a diagonal. Bathroom remodeling is one of the topics in our Google reviews, and one family says theirs looks amazing.

items.name: Flooring installation
items.blurb: New floors change how a whole room feels. We install flooring as its own project or as part of a remodel, like the bathroom and flooring job one family hired us to finish. They describe the new flooring as perfect and the craftsmanship as flawless.

about.text: Livingston General Contracting, LLC. is a family-owned general contracting business in Clarksville, Indiana. Bri and Trey are the names our customers mention in their reviews, and they are the people to call about your project. We remodel bathrooms, install flooring and build decks, and we are glad to step in when another company has left a project unfinished. Customers tell us they will hire us again, and one has already recommended us to her family. We are open weekdays from 8 AM to 5 PM.

items.name: Christina B.
items.text:
Livingston General Contracting, LLC Five stars for Livingston General Contracting, a great family owned business! We originally started our bathroom remodel and flooring project with Home Depot, but after they fell short and left us frustrated, this team stepped in and saved the day. They picked up right where the project lagged, communicated perfectly, and delivered flawless craftsmanship. The bathroom looks amazing and the new flooring is perfect. They were responsive, professional, personable, fast, and reliable, as well as QUALITY! Not to mention they also went above and beyond doing us a favor and returning items that were incorrectly ordered by Home Depot, prior to them taking over the job! We will be hiring them again for our next project! Save yourself the headache and hire them first!
Thanks again Bri and Trey!

items.name: Andrea A.
items.text: Saw a post they had on a Facebook page and loved the look of their deck.  Was a bit skeptical because didn’t know the people or the company. Had them out for estimate and they were super friendly, recommended what they thought would look best, and talked everything through. Would use them 100 times over again. Already recommended them to family.

items.name: Jesika S.
items.text: Bri and Trey at Livingston General Contracting are exceptional! Their dedication and hard work for clients are truly commendable. Their attention to detail ensures top-notch results, and their commitment to client satisfaction sets them apart. Working with them is a pleasure—professional, reliable, and results-driven. Highly recommend for any contracting needs!

service_area.text: Livingston General Contracting, LLC. works in Clarksville, IN. If you live in a nearby town and want to know whether we can take your project, call (812) 946-5652 between 8 AM and 5 PM on a weekday and tell us where you are. Whether you need a bathroom remodel, new flooring, a deck or someone to finish a stalled project, we will let you know if we can help.

items.q: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.a: We remodel bathrooms, install flooring and build wood decks with cable railings. Bathroom remodeling is one of the topics customers mention in our Google reviews, and our photos show a bathroom update and two new decks. Call us if your project is something else and we will tell you if it is a fit.

items.q: Can you finish a project another company started?
items.a: Yes. One family began a bathroom remodel and flooring project with a big retailer that fell short. We picked up right where it lagged, finished both, and returned items that had been ordered incorrectly before we took over. They now plan to hire us for their next project.

items.q: Will you come out for an estimate?
items.a: Yes. We come out to look at the project and give you an estimate. One homeowner who was unsure about hiring a company she did not know says we were super friendly at the estimate, recommended what we thought would look best and talked everything through.

Yes. Our photos show pressure-treated decks with wide stairs, capped posts and cable railings. One customer found us after seeing one of our decks in a Facebook post, and she has already recommended us to her family. Tell us how you plan to use the deck and we will suggest a layout.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and closed on weekends. Call (812) 946-5652 or email livingstongeneralcontracting@gmail.com to set up an estimate visit. Photos of the space and a short description of what you want done help us prepare for the visit.
